messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['Also refusing to acknowledge the right of self-determination to the Irish, while virtually his only input to Treaty of Versailles was the **right of self-determination**.', 'Facebook sent you a message.', 'The information do not match our record.', 'Michael J. Clarke made an online funds transfer to your account online.', 'This letter is to advise you about the order we have which is addressed to you.', 'This e-mail has been sent to you by HSBC UK to inform you that we were unable to verify your account details.', 'We are writing to let you know that our monitoring process has temporarily suspended your online banking access.', "It's either your information has been changed or incomplete, as a result your access to use our services has been limited.", 'A scheduled maintenance has just been completed on the ANZ Internet Banking system.', 'On routine audit check last month, I discovered some investment accounts that has been dormant for the last twelve(12) years.', 'Your account has been restricted from withdrawing and sending funds due to several logon attempts from different IP.', 'We are contacting you to remind you that our Account Review Team identified some unusual activity in your account.', 'Your account information was violated.', 'HSBC has temporarily suspended your online banking access.', 'your account will be deactivated within the next 48 hours due to several unsuccessful login attempt on your account.', 'Your account was recently reviewed, and we suspect that the detailed information on your account is not matching what we have...', 'This message confirms that you have changed your Lloyds TSB Security details.', 'We were able to trace it to an unknown link thereby, placing your online banking on suspension till this is resolved.', 'Your new official monthly statement is now available for you to view online.', 'Your account has been placed on hold', 'We recently noticed one or more attempts to log in your Halifax Online banking Account From a foreign IP address, and we have reasons to believe that your account was hijacked by third party without your authorization.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
